mapper.insert:
insert into batch_transfer_task_import ( batch_no, row_num, task_name, task_description, source_agent_id, source_agent_name, source_dir, target_dirs, include_patterns, exclude_patterns, scan_cron_expression, max_scan_files, target_agent_ids, target_agent_names, retry_enabled, retry_max_days, retry_interval_min, max_retry_count, retry_backoff_type, post_transfer_action, backup_dir, backup_mode, preserve_dir_structure, transfer_mode, routing_strategy, routing_config, status, scheduled_enabled, scheduled_start_time, scheduled_end_time, task_priority, started_at, validate_status, validate_message, import_status, imported_task_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, file_name ) values
( #{item.batchNo}, #{item.rowNum}, #{item.taskName}, #{item.taskDescription}, #{item.sourceAgentId}, #{item.sourceAgentName}, #{item.sourceDir}, #{item.targetDirs}, #{item.includePatterns}, #{item.excludePatterns}, #{item.scanCronExpression}, #{item.maxScanFiles}, #{item.targetAgentIds}, #{item.targetAgentNames}, #{item.retryEnabled}, #{item.retryMaxDays}, #{item.retryIntervalMin}, #{item.maxRetryCount}, #{item.retryBackoffType}, #{item.postTransferAction}, #{item.backupDir}, #{item.backupMode}, #{item.preserveDirStructure}, #{item.transferMode}, #{item.routingStrategy}, #{item.routingConfig}, #{item.status}, #{item.scheduledEnabled}, #{item.scheduledStartTime}, #{item.scheduledEndTime}, #{item.taskPriority}, #{item.startedAt}, #{item.validateStatus}, #{item.validateMessage}, #{item.importStatus}, #{item.importedTaskId}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.remark}, #{item.fileName} )
mapper.select: select from batch_transfer_task_import where batch_no = #{batchNo} order by row_num asc
select from batch_transfer_task_import where batch_no = #{batchNo} and import_status = #{importStatus} order by row_num asc
mapper.update: update batch_transfer_task_import set import_status = #{importStatus}, imported_task_id = #{importedTaskId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update batch_transfer_task_import set validate_status = #{validateStatus}, validate_message = #{validateMessage}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select batch_no, min(file_name) as file_name, count(*) as count, sum(case when validate_status = 'PASS' then 1 else 0 end) as pass_count, sum(case when validate_status = 'FAIL' then 1 else 0 end) as fail_count, case when sum(case when import_status = 'ROLLBACK' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'ROLLBACK' when sum(case when import_status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 'PENDING' else 'IMPORTED' end as import_status, min(create_time) as create_time from batch_transfer_task_import
and (batch_no like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') or file_name like concat('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
group by batch_no order by create_time desc
